target.description: Id of one {group} (its first {node} is used) or of one {node}

owner.description: INUBIT user or user group owning the workflows; default: inventory.owner of the {node}

diagramGroup.description: The diagram group whose technical workflows are archived

workflows.description: Only these workflows (case-sensitive names); default: all technical workflows of the diagram group, at most 50

targetFolder.description: Absolute path of the local folder for the archives; created owner-only if missing

acknowledgeClearTextSecrets.description: Must be true: the archives contain passwords, keys and other secrets in clear text

reason.description: Why the archives are exported; stored in the audit log
